title: Machine learning as a model for cultural learning: Teaching an algorithm what it means to be fat
findings: The model learned to associate words related to obesity (e.g., 'obese', 'overweight') with immorality. This 'immorality' dimension was constructed, in part, using anchor words with explicitly religious meaning, such as 'holy,' 'sacred,' 'piety,' and 'sin.' This indicates an indirect learned association between obesity and concepts of religious or moral impurity present in the text corpus.
